key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often recap is run while the menu is closed. The menu also refreshes the moment it is opened, and nothing is refreshed while the screen is locked.

key.name: recap-path
key.description: A bare name is looked up on PATH; an absolute path is used as given.

key.name: since
key.summary: Only sessions touched within this window
key.description: Passed to recap as --since (for example 24h, 90m, 2d). Empty leaves recap's own default in place.

key.name: project-roots
key.description: Each entry is passed to recap as --root. Empty leaves recap's own default (your home directory) in place.

key.name: show-count
key.summary: Show the session count next to the panel icon

key.name: hide-finished
key.summary: Hide finished sessions from the menu

key.name: hide-idle
key.summary: Hide idle sessions from the menu

key.name: terminal
key.summary: Terminal used to resume a session
key.description: The terminal emulator launched when a row is clicked. Empty picks the first one found on PATH.
